interpretation: Select a new target after the operator-selected Yi Ti test; this request is not evidence that Yi Ti is complete.

selection.reason: Dismounted crossbow field discovery test: direct Bound Crossbow damage 100 and two compatible 20-bolt stacks, base-only finite capacity 4000. Tied with Hightower Marksmen and Tarth Elite Crossbowman on these primary ranged inputs; Velaryon is the chosen test representative, not a proven superior troop. No skill-driven or melee superiority claim.

design.question: ranged_attack
design.population: 30 added/overridden ROT soldiers carrying crossbows; 39 distinct roster/weapon pairings. Not an all-role rank.
design.weapon_damage_source_fields: troop_equipment_audit.thrust_damage for type=Crossbow, cross-checked against items_direct
design.projectile_contribution: excluded from base-only capacity; raw bolt damage bonuses retained separately
design.weapon_speed_source_fields: raw speed_rating shown for audit only, not used as attacks per second or a multiplier
design.roster_aggregation: publish each roster separately; all three tied leading troops have exactly one roster, so their arithmetic mean equals that row
design.combination_rule: weapon_damage * sum(compatible bolt stack_amount in the same roster)
design.melee: No inference: secondary crafted sword damage/speed remains unknown

comparison.meaning: Base-weapon finite-ammunition index, not dealt damage, DPS, win probability, or percent troop superiority.

tie_policy.reason: Choose one representative of the strongest base-only crossbow package instead of spending three duplicate discovery cohorts. No superiority over the other tied troops is asserted.

historical_screen.scope: All tracked text files under data/combat_observations at the pinned source commit; original compressed archives and unuploaded tests not exhaustively searched.
historical_screen.freshness: GitHub comparison confirms main a318ae77 adds only PR105/106 audit/archive files and the queue; historical combat evidence and source audits are unchanged.
historical_screen.open_pr_screen: Only PR98 open; changed-file list contains the skill only, not the troop queue.

test_plan.formation: Separate ranged formation, dismounted, hold position with consistent infantry support. No dedicated melee test.
test_plan.confounders: Avoid established elite ranged anchors consuming most kills. Preserve complete side totals and all visible ordinary troop rows; keep siege and field separate.
test_plan.stop_rule: Review after five independent battles; not an automatic positive verdict or gate pass.
